judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng lì zhēn.
judgment_en: Primordial, prosperous, beneficial, correct.
lines_zh: 初九：潜龙勿用。
九二：见龙在田，利见大人。
九三：君子终日乾乾，夕惕若，厉，无咎。
九四：或跃在渊，无咎。
九五：飞龙在天，利见大人。
上九：亢龙有悔。 用九：见群龙无首，吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Qián lóng wù yòng.
Jiǔ èr: Jiàn lóng zài tián, lì jiàn dà rén.
Jiǔ sān: Jūn zǐ zhōng rì qián qián, xī tì ruò, lì, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sì: Huò yuè zài yuān, wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Fēi lóng zài tiān, lì jiàn dà rén.
Shàng jiǔ: Kàng lóng yǒu huǐ. Yòng jiǔ: Jiàn qún lóng wú shǒu, jí.
lines_en: First line: Hidden dragon. Do not act.
Second line: The dragon appears in the field. Favorable to see the great man.
Third line: The noble one is active all day and wary at night. Danger, no blame.
Fourth line: Perhaps leaping in the deep. No blame.
Fifth line: Flying dragon in the heavens. Favorable to see the great man.
Top line: The overreaching dragon has regret. (Use of Nines: a host of dragons without a leader — good fortune.)

judgment_zh: 元亨，利牝馬之貞。君子有攸往，先迷後得主，利西南得朋，東北喪朋。安貞，吉。
judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng, lì pìn mǎ zhī zhēn. Jūn zǐ yǒu yōu wǎng, xiān mí hòu dé zhǔ, lì xī nán dé péng, dōng běi sàng péng. Ān zhēn, jí.
judgment_en: Supreme success; favorable is the perseverance of a mare. The noble one has somewhere to go: first lost, later he finds a master. Favorable to gain friends in the southwest, to lose friends in the northeast. Quiet perseverance brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六：履霜，堅冰至。
六二：直，方，大，不習无不利。
六三：含章可貞。或從王事，无成有終。
六四：括囊；无咎，无譽。
六五：黃裳，元吉。
上六：龍戰于野，其血玄黃。 用六：利永貞。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Lǚ shuāng, jiān bīng zhì.
Liù èr: Zhí, fāng, dà, bù xí wú bù lì.
Liù sān: Hán zhāng kě zhēn. Huò cóng wáng shì, wú chéng yǒu zhōng.
Liù sì: Kuò náng; wú jiù, wú yù.
Liù wǔ: Huáng shang, yuán jí.
Shàng liù: Lóng zhàn yú yě, qí xuè xuán huáng. Yòng liù: Lì yǒng zhēn.
lines_en: First line: Treading on frost, solid ice is coming.
Second line: Straight, square, great. Without practice, nothing is unfavorable.
Third line: Hidden brilliance; one can persevere. If serving the king, no achievement of one's own, but a good end.
Fourth line: A tied-up sack. No blame, no praise.
Fifth line: A yellow lower garment. Supreme good fortune.
Top line: Dragons fight in the wild; their blood is dark and yellow. (Use of Sixes: favorable is lasting perseverance.)

judgment_zh: 元亨，利貞，勿用有攸往，利建侯。
judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng, lì zhēn, wù yòng yǒu yōu wǎng, lì jiàn hóu.
judgment_en: Supreme success, favorable perseverance. Do not set out anywhere. Favorable to establish lords.
lines_zh: 初九：磐桓；利居貞，利建侯。
六二：屯如邅如，乘馬班如。匪寇婚媾，女子貞不字，十年乃字。
六三：即鹿无虞，惟入于林中，君子幾不如舍，往吝。
六四：乘馬班如，求婚媾，往吉，无不利。
九五：屯其膏，小貞吉，大貞凶。
上六：乘馬班如，泣血漣如。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Pán huán; lì jū zhēn, lì jiàn hóu.
Liù èr: Tún rú zhān rú, chéng mǎ bān rú. Fěi kòu hūn gòu, nǚ zǐ zhēn bù zì, shí nián nǎi zì.
Liù sān: Jí lù wú yú, wéi rù yú lín zhōng, jūn zǐ jǐ bù rú shě, wǎng lìn.
Liù sì: Chéng mǎ bān rú, qiú hūn gòu, wǎng jí, wú bù lì.
Jiǔ wǔ: Tún qí gāo, xiǎo zhēn jí, dà zhēn xiōng.
Shàng liù: Chéng mǎ bān rú, qì xuè lián rú.
lines_en: First line: Hesitating, circling. Favorable to remain persevering; favorable to establish lords.
Second line: Difficulty, wavering; horse and carriage turn back. Not a robber — a suitor. The maiden stays chaste and does not pledge herself; after ten years she pledges.
Third line: Chasing deer without a forester, one only strays into the forest. The noble one sees the signs and gives it up; going on brings humiliation.
Fourth line: Horse and carriage turn back. Seek the union; going brings good fortune, nothing unfavorable.
Fifth line: Difficulty in bestowing favor. Small perseverance, good fortune; great perseverance, misfortune.
Top line: Horse and carriage turn back; tears of blood flow.

judgment_zh: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告。利貞。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Fěi wǒ qiú tóng méng, tóng méng qiú wǒ. Chū shì gào, zài sān dú, dú zé bù gào. Lì zhēn.
judgment_en: Success. I do not seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me. The first divination I answer; asking two or three times is disrespect, and I do not answer. Favorable perseverance.
lines_zh: 初六：發蒙，利用刑人，用說桎梏，以往吝。
九二：包蒙吉；納婦吉；子克家。
六三：勿用取女；見金夫，不有躬，无攸利。
六四：困蒙，吝。
六五：童蒙，吉。
上九：擊蒙；不利為寇，利禦寇。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Fā méng, lì yòng xíng rén, yòng shuō zhì gù, yǐ wǎng lìn.
Jiǔ èr: Bāo méng jí; nà fù jí; zi kè jiā.
Liù sān: Wù yòng qǔ nǚ; jiàn jīn fū, bù yǒu gōng, wú yōu lì.
Liù sì: Kùn méng, lìn.
Liù wǔ: Tóng méng, jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Jī méng; bù lì wèi kòu, lì yù kòu.
lines_en: First line: To dispel folly, it is favorable to use discipline and remove the fetters; to go on that way brings humiliation.
Second line: Bearing with the foolish brings good fortune. Taking a wife brings good fortune. The son can manage the household.
Third line: Do not take this woman: seeing a man of gold, she loses herself. Nothing favorable.
Fourth line: Folly trapped. Humiliation.
Fifth line: Childlike folly. Good fortune.
Top line: Striking at folly. Not favorable to be the raider; favorable to repel raiders.

judgment_zh: 有孚，光亨，貞吉。利涉大川。
judgment_pinyin: Yǒu fú, guāng hēng, zhēn jí. Lì shè dà chuān.
judgment_en: There is sincerity; bright success. Perseverance brings good fortune. Favorable to cross the great river.
lines_zh: 初九：需于郊。利用恆，无咎。
九二：需于沙。小有言，終吉。
九三：需于泥，致寇至。
六四：需于血，出自穴。
九五：需于酒食，貞吉。
上六：入于穴，有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Xū yú jiāo. Lì yòng héng, wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Xū yú shā. Xiǎo yǒu yán, zhōng jí.
Jiǔ sān: Xū yú ní, zhì kòu zhì.
Liù sì: Xū yú xuè, chū zì xué.
Jiǔ wǔ: Xū yú jiǔ shí, zhēn jí.
Shàng liù: Rù yú xué, yǒu bù sù zhī kè sān rén lái, jìng zhī zhōng jí.
lines_en: First line: Waiting in the outskirts. Favorable to stay constant. No blame.
Second line: Waiting on the sand. Some gossip, but good fortune in the end.
Third line: Waiting in the mud invites raiders.
Fourth line: Waiting in blood. Get out of the pit.
Fifth line: Waiting with wine and food. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Top line: Falling into the pit. Three uninvited guests arrive; treat them with respect, and in the end good fortune.

judgment_zh: 有孚，窒。惕中吉。終凶。利見大人，不利涉大川。
judgment_pinyin: Yǒu fú, zhì. Tì zhōng jí. Zhōng xiōng. Lì jiàn dà rén, bù lì shè dà chuān.
judgment_en: There is sincerity, but it is obstructed. Caution midway brings good fortune; pressing to the end brings misfortune. Favorable to see the great man; not favorable to cross the great river.
lines_zh: 初六：不永所事，小有言，終吉。
九二：不克訟，歸而逋，其邑人三百戶，无眚。
六三：食舊德，貞厲，終吉，或從王事，无成。
九四：不克訟，復即命渝，安貞吉。
九五：訟元吉。
上九：或錫之鞶帶，終朝三褫之。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Bù yǒng suǒ shì, xiǎo yǒu yán, zhōng jí.
Jiǔ èr: Bù kè sòng, guī ér bū, qí yì rén sān bǎi hù, wú shěng.
Liù sān: Shí jiù dé, zhēn lì, zhōng jí, huò cóng wáng shì, wú chéng.
Jiǔ sì: Bù kè sòng, fù jí mìng yú, ān zhēn jí.
Jiǔ wǔ: Sòng yuán jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Huò xī zhī pán dài, zhōng cháo sān chǐ zhī.
lines_en: First line: Not prolonging the matter. Some gossip, but good fortune in the end.
Second line: Unable to win the dispute, he returns home and withdraws. The three hundred households of his town are spared harm.
Third line: Living on old virtue. Perseverance amid danger; good fortune in the end. If serving the king, no achievement.
Fourth line: Unable to win the dispute, he turns back, accepts his lot and changes. Quiet perseverance brings good fortune.
Fifth line: Dispute: supreme good fortune.
Top line: Perhaps awarded a leather belt, it is stripped away three times before the morning ends.

judgment_pinyin: Zhēn, zhàng rén, jí wú jiù.
judgment_en: Perseverance. A mature leader brings good fortune; no blame.
lines_zh: 初六：師出以律，否臧凶。
九二：在師中吉，无咎，王三錫命。
六三：師或輿尸，凶。
六四：師左次，无咎。
六五：田有禽，利執言，无咎。長子帥師，弟子輿尸，貞凶。
上六：大君有命，開國承家，小人勿用。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Shī chū yǐ lǜ, fǒu zāng xiōng.
Jiǔ èr: Zài shī zhōng jí, wú jiù, wáng sān xī mìng.
Liù sān: Shī huò yú shī, xiōng.
Liù sì: Shī zuǒ cì, wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Tián yǒu qín, lì zhí yán, wú jiù. Zhǎng zi shuài shī, dì zǐ yú shī, zhēn xiōng.
Shàng liù: Dà jūn yǒu mìng, kāi guó chéng jiā, xiǎo rén wù yòng.
lines_en: First line: The army sets out with discipline. Without order, misfortune.
Second line: In the midst of the army, good fortune; no blame. The king grants a threefold commendation.
Third line: The army may carry corpses in the cart. Misfortune.
Fourth line: The army retreats and camps. No blame.
Fifth line: There is game in the field; favorable to seize it. No blame. The eldest son leads the army; if the younger son carts corpses, perseverance brings misfortune.
Top line: The great ruler issues his charge, founding states and granting fiefs. Do not employ petty people.

judgment_zh: 吉。原筮元永貞，无咎。不寧方來，後夫凶。
judgment_pinyin: Jí. Yuán shì yuán yǒng zhēn, wú jiù. Bù níng fāng lái, hòu fū xiōng.
judgment_en: Good fortune. Divine again: supreme, lasting perseverance; no blame. The restless come from all sides; the latecomer meets misfortune.
lines_zh: 初六：有孚，比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來有它吉。
六二：比之自內，貞吉。
六三：比之匪人。
六四：外比之，貞吉。
九五：顯比，王用三驅，失前禽。邑人不誡，吉。
上六：比之无首，凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Yǒu fú, bǐ zhī, wú jiù. Yǒu fú yíng fǒu, zhōng lái yǒu tā jí.
Liù èr: Bǐ zhī zì nèi, zhēn jí.
Liù sān: Bǐ zhī fěi rén.
Liù sì: Wài bǐ zhī, zhēn jí.
Jiǔ wǔ: Xiǎn bǐ, wáng yòng sān qū, shī qián qín. Yì rén bù jiè, jí.
Shàng liù: Bǐ zhī wú shǒu, xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Holding to him in sincerity: no blame. Sincerity fills the earthen bowl; in the end other good fortune comes.
Second line: Holding to him from within. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: Holding to the wrong people.
Fourth line: Holding to him from outside. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Fifth line: Open union. The king hunts on three sides and lets the game ahead escape. The townspeople need no warning. Good fortune.
Top line: Union without a head. Misfortune.

title_en: The Taming Power of the Small
judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Mì yún bù yǔ, zì wǒ xī jiāo.
judgment_en: Success. Dense clouds, no rain, from our western outskirts.
lines_zh: 初九：復自道，何其咎，吉。
九二：牽復，吉。
九三：輿說輻，夫妻反目。
六四：有孚，血去惕出，无咎。
九五：有孚攣如，富以其鄰。
上九：既雨既處，尚德載，婦貞厲。月幾望，君子征凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Fù zì dào, hé qí jiù, jí.
Jiǔ èr: Qiān fù, jí.
Jiǔ sān: Yú shuō fú, fū qī fǎn mù.
Liù sì: Yǒu fú, xuè qù tì chū, wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Yǒu fú luán rú, fù yǐ qí lín.
Shàng jiǔ: Jì yǔ jì chù, shàng dé zài, fù zhēn lì. Yuè jǐ wàng, jūn zǐ zhēng xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Returning to one's own way — how could that be blame? Good fortune.
Second line: Drawn back to return. Good fortune.
Third line: The cart loses its axle-spokes. Husband and wife turn away from each other.
Fourth line: There is sincerity: blood goes, fear departs. No blame.
Fifth line: Sincerity that binds together, sharing wealth with one's neighbor.
Top line: The rain has come, rest has come; virtue is held in high regard. For the wife, perseverance is dangerous. The moon is nearly full; if the noble one sets forth, misfortune.

judgment_pinyin: Lǚ hǔ wěi, bù xì rén, hēng.
judgment_en: Treading on the tiger's tail; it does not bite. Success.
lines_zh: 初九：素履，往无咎。
九二：履道坦坦，幽人貞吉。
六三：眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人，凶。武人為于大君。
九四：履虎尾，愬愬，終吉。
九五：夬履，貞厲。
上九：視履考祥，其旋元吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Sù lǚ, wǎng wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Lǚ dào tǎn tǎn, yōu rén zhēn jí.
Liù sān: Miǎo néng shì, bǒ néng lǚ, lǚ hǔ wěi, xì rén, xiōng. Wǔ rén wèi yú dà jūn.
Jiǔ sì: Lǚ hǔ wěi, sù sù, zhōng jí.
Jiǔ wǔ: Guài lǚ, zhēn lì.
Shàng jiǔ: Shì lǚ kǎo xiáng, qí xuán yuán jí.
lines_en: First line: Plain treading. Going on, no blame.
Second line: Treading a level, easy path. The recluse's perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: The one-eyed can see, the lame can walk; treading on the tiger's tail, he is bitten. Misfortune. A warrior acting for his great lord.
Fourth line: Treading on the tiger's tail with great caution. Good fortune in the end.
Fifth line: Resolute treading. Perseverance amid danger.
Top line: Look at your conduct and examine the omens. If it comes full circle, supreme good fortune.

judgment_pinyin: Xiǎo wǎng dà lái, jí hēng.
judgment_en: The small departs, the great arrives. Good fortune, success.
lines_zh: 初九：拔茅茹，以其彙，征吉。
九二：包荒，用馮河，不遐遺，朋亡，得尚于中行。
九三：无平不陂，无往不復，艱貞无咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。
六四：翩翩，不富，以其鄰，不戒以孚。
六五：帝乙歸妹，以祉元吉。
上六：城復于隍，勿用師。自邑告命，貞吝。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Bá máo rú, yǐ qí huì, zhēng jí.
Jiǔ èr: Bāo huāng, yòng féng hé, bù xiá yí, péng wáng, dé shàng yú zhōng háng.
Jiǔ sān: Wú píng bù bēi, wú wǎng bù fù, jiān zhēn wú jiù. Wù xù qí fú, yú shí yǒu fú.
Liù sì: Piān piān, bù fù, yǐ qí lín, bù jiè yǐ fú.
Liù wǔ: Dì yǐ guī mèi, yǐ zhǐ yuán jí.
Shàng liù: Chéng fù yú huáng, wù yòng shī. Zì yì gào mìng, zhēn lìn.
lines_en: First line: Pulling up reeds, roots and all, together with their kind. Setting forth brings good fortune.
Second line: Embracing the rough, crossing the river on foot, not neglecting the distant, setting aside cliques: so one keeps to the middle way.
Third line: No plain without a slope, no going without return. Perseverance in hardship: no blame. Do not worry over your sincerity; there is blessing in your livelihood.
Fourth line: Fluttering down, not relying on wealth, together with one's neighbor; trusting without being warned.
Fifth line: Emperor Yi gives his younger sister in marriage. Blessing and supreme good fortune.
Top line: The city wall falls back into the moat. Do not use the army. Issue orders within your own town. Perseverance brings humiliation.

judgment_zh: 否之匪人，不利君子貞，大往小來。
judgment_pinyin: Fǒu zhī fěi rén, bù lì jūn zǐ zhēn, dà wǎng xiǎo lái.
judgment_en: Blocked by the wrong people. Not favorable for the noble one's perseverance. The great departs, the small arrives.
lines_zh: 初六：拔茅茹，以其彙，貞吉亨。
六二：包承。小人吉，大人否，亨。
六三：包羞。
九四：有命，无咎，疇離祉。
九五：休否，大人吉。其亡其亡，繫于苞桑。
上九：傾否，先否後喜。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Bá máo rú, yǐ qí huì, zhēn jí hēng.
Liù èr: Bāo chéng. Xiǎo rén jí, dà rén fǒu, hēng.
Liù sān: Bāo xiū.
Jiǔ sì: Yǒu mìng, wú jiù, chóu lí zhǐ.
Jiǔ wǔ: Xiū fǒu, dà rén jí. Qí wáng qí wáng, xì yú bāo sāng.
Shàng jiǔ: Qīng fǒu, xiān fǒu hòu xǐ.
lines_en: First line: Pulling up reeds, roots and all, together with their kind. Perseverance brings good fortune and success.
Second line: Bearing and submitting. Good fortune for the petty person; the great man stays blocked, and so succeeds.
Third line: Bearing shame.
Fourth line: Acting on a mandate: no blame. Companions share the blessing.
Fifth line: Stagnation comes to rest; good fortune for the great man. "It may perish, it may perish!" — tie it to the mulberry roots.
Top line: Stagnation overturned. First blocked, then joy.

judgment_zh: 同人于野，亨。利涉大川，利君子貞。
judgment_pinyin: Tóng rén yú yě, hēng. Lì shè dà chuān, lì jūn zǐ zhēn.
judgment_en: Fellowship in the open field. Success. Favorable to cross the great river; favorable is the noble one's perseverance.
lines_zh: 初九：同人于門，无咎。
六二：同人于宗，吝。
九三：伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三歲不興。
九四：乘其墉，弗克攻，吉。
九五：同人，先號咷而後笑。大師克相遇。
上九：同人于郊，无悔。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Tóng rén yú mén, wú jiù.
Liù èr: Tóng rén yú zōng, lìn.
Jiǔ sān: Fú róng yú mǎng, shēng qí gāo líng, sān suì bù xìng.
Jiǔ sì: Chéng qí yōng, fú kè gōng, jí.
Jiǔ wǔ: Tóng rén, xiān hào táo ér hòu xiào. Dà shī kè xiāng yù.
Shàng jiǔ: Tóng rén yú jiāo, wú huǐ.
lines_en: First line: Fellowship at the gate. No blame.
Second line: Fellowship within the clan. Humiliation.
Third line: Troops hidden in the thickets, he climbs the high hill. For three years he does not rise.
Fourth line: He mounts the city wall but cannot attack. Good fortune.
Fifth line: Fellowship: first weeping and wailing, then laughter. The great armies succeed in meeting.
Top line: Fellowship in the outskirts. No regret.

judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng.
judgment_en: Supreme success.
lines_zh: 初九：无交害，匪咎，艱則无咎。
九二：大車以載，有攸往，无咎。
九三：公用亨于天子，小人弗克。
九四：匪其彭，无咎。
六五：厥孚交如，威如；吉。
上九：自天祐之，吉无不利。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Wú jiāo hài, fěi jiù, jiān zé wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Dà chē yǐ zài, yǒu yōu wǎng, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sān: Gōng yòng hēng yú tiān zi, xiǎo rén fú kè.
Jiǔ sì: Fěi qí péng, wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Jué fú jiāo rú, wēi rú; jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Zì tiān yòu zhī, jí wú bù lì.
lines_en: First line: No dealings with harm, so no fault. Mindful of hardship, no blame.
Second line: A great cart for loading. Somewhere to go; no blame.
Third line: The duke makes an offering to the Son of Heaven; a petty person cannot.
Fourth line: Not flaunting one's abundance. No blame.
Fifth line: His sincerity is mutual and commands respect. Good fortune.
Top line: Blessed by Heaven. Good fortune; nothing unfavorable.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng, jūn zǐ yǒu zhōng.
judgment_en: Success. The noble one carries things through.
lines_zh: 初六：謙謙君子，用涉大川，吉。
六二：鳴謙，貞吉。
九三：勞謙，君子有終，吉。
六四：无不利，撝謙。
六五：不富，以其鄰，利用侵伐，无不利。
上六：鳴謙，利用行師，征邑國。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Qiān qiān jūn zǐ, yòng shè dà chuān, jí.
Liù èr: Míng qiān, zhēn jí.
Jiǔ sān: Láo qiān, jūn zǐ yǒu zhōng, jí.
Liù sì: Wú bù lì, huī qiān.
Liù wǔ: Bù fù, yǐ qí lín, lì yòng qīn fá, wú bù lì.
Shàng liù: Míng qiān, lì yòng xíng shī, zhēng yì guó.
lines_en: First line: Modest, modest is the noble one; he crosses the great river. Good fortune.
Second line: Modesty that is heard. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: Toiling modesty. The noble one carries things through. Good fortune.
Fourth line: Nothing unfavorable; modesty in action.
Fifth line: Not relying on wealth, together with one's neighbor. Favorable to attack; nothing unfavorable.
Top line: Modesty that is heard. Favorable to set the army marching to bring order to one's own city and state.

judgment_pinyin: Lì jiàn hóu, xíng shī.
judgment_en: Favorable to establish lords and set the army marching.
lines_zh: 初六：鳴豫，凶。
六二：介于石，不終日，貞吉。
六三：盱豫，悔。遲有悔。
九四：由豫，大有得。勿疑。朋盍簪。
六五：貞疾，恆不死。
上六：冥豫，成有渝，无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Míng yù, xiōng.
Liù èr: Jiè yú shí, bù zhōng rì, zhēn jí.
Liù sān: Xū yù, huǐ. Chí yǒu huǐ.
Jiǔ sì: Yóu yù, dà yǒu dé. Wù yí. Péng hé zān.
Liù wǔ: Zhēn jí, héng bù sǐ.
Shàng liù: Míng yù, chéng yǒu yú, wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: Enthusiasm that boasts. Misfortune.
Second line: Firm as a rock, not waiting a whole day. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: Enthusiasm that looks upward brings regret. Delay brings regret.
Fourth line: The source of enthusiasm; great things are gained. Do not doubt; friends gather like hair in a clasp.
Fifth line: Persistently ill, yet does not die.
Top line: Enthusiasm in the dark. Once done, if it changes, no blame.

judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng lì zhēn, wú jiù.
judgment_en: Supreme success, favorable perseverance. No blame.
lines_zh: 初九：官有渝，貞吉。出門交有功。
六二：系小子，失丈夫。
六三：系丈夫，失小子。隨有求得，利居貞。
九四：隨有獲，貞凶。有孚在道，以明，何咎。
九五：孚于嘉，吉。
上六：拘系之，乃從維之。王用亨于西山。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Guān yǒu yú, zhēn jí. Chū mén jiāo yǒu gōng.
Liù èr: Xì xiǎo zi, shī zhàng fū.
Liù sān: Xì zhàng fū, shī xiǎo zi. Suí yǒu qiú dé, lì jū zhēn.
Jiǔ sì: Suí yǒu huò, zhēn xiōng. Yǒu fú zài dào, yǐ míng, hé jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Fú yú jiā, jí.
Shàng liù: Jū xì zhī, nǎi cóng wéi zhī. Wáng yòng hēng yú xī shān.
lines_en: First line: The standard changes. Perseverance brings good fortune. Going out the gate to meet others brings achievement.
Second line: Clinging to the little boy, one loses the grown man.
Third line: Clinging to the grown man, one loses the little boy. Following, one gets what one seeks. Favorable to remain persevering.
Fourth line: Following brings gains, but perseverance brings misfortune. With sincerity on the way, and clarity, how could there be blame?
Fifth line: Sincere toward the good. Good fortune.
Top line: Held fast and bound to him. The king makes an offering on the Western Mountain.

title_en: Decay (Work on What Has Been Spoiled)
judgment_zh: 元亨，利涉大川。先甲三日，後甲三日。
judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng, lì shè dà chuān. Xiān jiǎ sān rì, hòu jiǎ sān rì.
judgment_en: Supreme success. Favorable to cross the great river. Three days before the starting day, three days after.
lines_zh: 初六：幹父之蠱，有子，考无咎，厲終吉。
九二：幹母之蠱，不可貞。
九三：幹父之蠱，小有悔，无大咎。
六四：裕父之蠱，往見吝。
六五：幹父之蠱，用譽。
上九：不事王侯，高尚其事。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Gàn fù zhī gǔ, yǒu zi, kǎo wú jiù, lì zhōng jí.
Jiǔ èr: Gàn mǔ zhī gǔ, bù kě zhēn.
Jiǔ sān: Gàn fù zhī gǔ, xiǎo yǒu huǐ, wú dà jiù.
Liù sì: Yù fù zhī gǔ, wǎng jiàn lìn.
Liù wǔ: Gàn fù zhī gǔ, yòng yù.
Shàng jiǔ: Bù shì wáng hóu, gāo shàng qí shì.
lines_en: First line: Setting right what the father spoiled. With such a son, the late father is without blame. Danger, but good fortune in the end.
Second line: Setting right what the mother spoiled. One cannot be too rigid.
Third line: Setting right what the father spoiled. Small regret, no great blame.
Fourth line: Tolerating what the father spoiled. Going on brings humiliation.
Fifth line: Setting right what the father spoiled. One gains praise.
Top line: He does not serve kings and lords; he holds his own aims higher.

judgment_zh: 元，亨，利，貞。至于八月有凶。
judgment_pinyin: Yuán, hēng, lì, zhēn. Zhì yú bā yuè yǒu xiōng.
judgment_en: Supreme, prosperous, beneficial, correct. When the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune.
lines_zh: 初九：咸臨，貞吉。
九二：咸臨，吉无不利。
六三：甘臨，无攸利。既憂之，无咎。
六四：至臨，无咎。
六五：知臨，大君之宜，吉。
上六：敦臨，吉无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Xián lín, zhēn jí.
Jiǔ èr: Xián lín, jí wú bù lì.
Liù sān: Gān lín, wú yōu lì. Jì yōu zhī, wú jiù.
Liù sì: Zhì lín, wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Zhī lín, dà jūn zhī yí, jí.
Shàng liù: Dūn lín, jí wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: Approach together. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Second line: Approach together. Good fortune; nothing unfavorable.
Third line: Comfortable approach. Nothing favorable. If one is concerned about it, no blame.
Fourth line: Complete approach. No blame.
Fifth line: Wise approach, fitting for a great ruler. Good fortune.
Top line: Generous approach. Good fortune; no blame.

judgment_pinyin: Guàn ér bù jiàn, yǒu fú yóng ruò.
judgment_en: The hands are washed, but the offering not yet made. Full of sincerity, they look up in reverence.
lines_zh: 初六：童觀，小人无咎，君子吝。
六二：闚觀，利女貞。
六三：觀我生，進退。
六四：觀國之光，利用賓于王。
九五：觀我生，君子无咎。
上九：觀其生，君子无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Tóng guān, xiǎo rén wú jiù, jūn zǐ lìn.
Liù èr: Kuī guān, lì nǚ zhēn.
Liù sān: Guān wǒ shēng, jìn tuì.
Liù sì: Guān guó zhī guāng, lì yòng bīn yú wáng.
Jiǔ wǔ: Guān wǒ shēng, jūn zǐ wú jiù.
Shàng jiǔ: Guān qí shēng, jūn zǐ wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: A child's view. For the petty person no blame; for the noble one, humiliation.
Second line: Peeking through the door. Favorable for a woman's perseverance.
Third line: Contemplating my own life, to decide advance or retreat.
Fourth line: Contemplating the glory of the state. Favorable to be the king's guest.
Fifth line: Contemplating my own life. The noble one is without blame.
Top line: Contemplating his life. The noble one is without blame.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Lì yòng yù.
judgment_en: Success. Favorable to administer justice.
lines_zh: 初九：屨校滅趾，无咎。
六二：噬膚滅鼻，无咎。
六三：噬臘肉，遇毒；小吝，无咎。
九四：噬乾胏，得金矢，利艱貞，吉。
六五：噬乾肉，得黃金，貞厲，无咎。
上九：何校滅耳，凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Jù xiào miè zhǐ, wú jiù.
Liù èr: Shì fū miè bí, wú jiù.
Liù sān: Shì là ròu, yù dú; xiǎo lìn, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sì: Shì qián zǐ, dé jīn shǐ, lì jiān zhēn, jí.
Liù wǔ: Shì qián ròu, dé huáng jīn, zhēn lì, wú jiù.
Shàng jiǔ: Hé xiào miè ěr, xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Feet in the stocks, toes cut off from view. No blame.
Second line: Biting through tender meat, the nose disappears. No blame.
Third line: Biting dried meat, one meets poison. Slight humiliation; no blame.
Fourth line: Biting dried meat on the bone, one gets metal arrows. Favorable to persevere in hardship. Good fortune.
Fifth line: Biting dried lean meat, one gets yellow gold. Perseverance amid danger; no blame.
Top line: Neck in the wooden collar, ears cut off from view. Misfortune.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Xiǎo lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
judgment_en: Success. Small gains in going somewhere.
lines_zh: 初九：賁其趾，舍車而徒。
六二：賁其須。
九三：賁如濡如，永貞吉。
六四：賁如皤如，白馬翰如，匪寇婚媾。
六五：賁于丘園，束帛戔戔，吝，終吉。
上九：白賁，无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Bì qí zhǐ, shě chē ér tú.
Liù èr: Bì qí xū.
Jiǔ sān: Bì rú rú rú, yǒng zhēn jí.
Liù sì: Bì rú pó rú, bái mǎ hàn rú, fěi kòu hūn gòu.
Liù wǔ: Bì yú qiū yuán, shù bó jiān jiān, lìn, zhōng jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Bái bì, wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: Adorning his feet, he leaves the carriage and walks.
Second line: Adorning the beard.
Third line: Adorned and glistening. Lasting perseverance brings good fortune.
Fourth line: Adorned, or plain white? A white horse comes as if flying. Not a robber — a suitor.
Fifth line: Adornment in hills and gardens; the roll of silk is meager. Humiliation, but good fortune in the end.
Top line: Plain white adornment. No blame.

judgment_pinyin: Bù lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
judgment_en: Not favorable to go anywhere.
lines_zh: 初六：剝床以足，蔑貞凶。
六二：剝床以辨，蔑貞凶。
六三：剝之，无咎。
六四：剝床以膚，凶。
六五：貫魚，以宮人寵，无不利。
上九：碩果不食，君子得輿，小人剝廬。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Bō chuáng yǐ zú, miè zhēn xiōng.
Liù èr: Bō chuáng yǐ biàn, miè zhēn xiōng.
Liù sān: Bō zhī, wú jiù.
Liù sì: Bō chuáng yǐ fū, xiōng.
Liù wǔ: Guàn yú, yǐ gōng rén chǒng, wú bù lì.
Shàng jiǔ: Shuò guǒ bù shí, jūn zǐ dé yú, xiǎo rén bō lú.
lines_en: First line: The bed is split at the legs. Perseverance is destroyed. Misfortune.
Second line: The bed is split at the frame. Perseverance is destroyed. Misfortune.
Third line: Splitting apart from them. No blame.
Fourth line: The bed is split down to the skin. Misfortune.
Fifth line: A string of fish: favor through the palace ladies. Nothing unfavorable.
Top line: A large fruit left uneaten. The noble one gains a carriage; the petty person's house is split apart.

judgment_zh: 亨。出入无疾，朋來无咎。反復其道，七日來復，利有攸往。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Chū rù wú jí, péng lái wú jiù. Fǎn fù qí dào, qī rì lái fù, lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
judgment_en: Success. Going out and coming in without harm; friends come, no blame. Back and forth on the way; in seven days comes return. Favorable to go somewhere.
lines_zh: 初九：不遠復，无祗悔，元吉。
六二：休復，吉。
六三：頻復，厲无咎。
六四：中行獨復。
六五：敦復，无悔。
上六：迷復，凶，有災眚。用行師，終有大敗，以其國君，凶；至于十年，不克征。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Bù yuǎn fù, wú zhī huǐ, yuán jí.
Liù èr: Xiū fù, jí.
Liù sān: Pín fù, lì wú jiù.
Liù sì: Zhōng háng dú fù.
Liù wǔ: Dūn fù, wú huǐ.
Shàng liù: Mí fù, xiōng, yǒu zāi shěng. Yòng xíng shī, zhōng yǒu dà bài, yǐ qí guó jūn, xiōng; zhì yú shí nián, bù kè zhēng.
lines_en: First line: Returning from not far away. No great regret. Supreme good fortune.
Second line: Restful return. Good fortune.
Third line: Repeated return. Danger, no blame.
Fourth line: Walking in the middle of the group, returning alone.
Fifth line: Sincere return. No regret.
Top line: Lost on the way back. Misfortune; disaster within and without. Send the army, and in the end a great defeat, misfortune for the ruler of the state; for ten years one cannot march again.

judgment_zh: 元亨，利貞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng, lì zhēn. Qí fěi zhèng yǒu shěng, bù lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
judgment_en: Supreme success, favorable perseverance. If one is not upright, there is harm; not favorable to go anywhere.
lines_zh: 初九：无妄，往吉。
六二：不耕獲，不菑畬，則利有攸往。
六三：无妄之災，或繫之牛，行人之得，邑人之災。
九四：可貞，无咎。
九五：无妄之疾，勿藥有喜。
上九：无妄，行有眚，无攸利。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Wú wàng, wǎng jí.
Liù èr: Bù gēng huò, bù zāi shē, zé lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
Liù sān: Wú wàng zhī zāi, huò xì zhī niú, xíng rén zhī dé, yì rén zhī zāi.
Jiǔ sì: Kě zhēn, wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Wú wàng zhī jí, wù yào yǒu xǐ.
Shàng jiǔ: Wú wàng, xíng yǒu shěng, wú yōu lì.
lines_en: First line: Without falsehood, going brings good fortune.
Second line: Reaping without plowing, harvesting without clearing: then it is favorable to go somewhere.
Third line: Undeserved misfortune: someone ties up an ox — the passer-by's gain is the townsman's loss.
Fourth line: One can persevere. No blame.
Fifth line: An illness not of one's making: take no medicine, and there will be joy.
Top line: Without falsehood, yet acting brings harm. Nothing favorable.

judgment_zh: 利貞，不家食吉，利涉大川。
judgment_pinyin: Lì zhēn, bù jiā shí jí, lì shè dà chuān.
judgment_en: Favorable perseverance. Not eating at home brings good fortune. Favorable to cross the great river.
lines_zh: 初九：有厲利已。
九二：輿說輹。
九三：良馬逐，利艱貞。曰閑輿衛，利有攸往。
六四：童牛之牿，元吉。
六五：豶豕之牙，吉。
上九：何天之衢，亨。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Yǒu lì lì yǐ.
Jiǔ èr: Yú shuō fù.
Jiǔ sān: Liáng mǎ zhú, lì jiān zhēn. Yuē xián yú wèi, lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
Liù sì: Tóng niú zhī gù, yuán jí.
Liù wǔ: Fén shǐ zhī yá, jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Hé tiān zhī qú, hēng.
lines_en: First line: There is danger. Favorable to stop.
Second line: The cart's axle-block comes off.
Third line: A fine horse in pursuit. Favorable to persevere in hardship. Practice chariot driving and defense daily. Favorable to go somewhere.
Fourth line: A guard board on a young bull's horns. Supreme good fortune.
Fifth line: The tusks of a gelded boar. Good fortune.
Top line: Receiving the highway of Heaven. Success.

judgment_pinyin: Zhēn jí. Guān yí, zì qiú kǒu shí.
judgment_en: Perseverance brings good fortune. Watch how one is nourished; seek one's own food.
lines_zh: 初九：舍爾靈龜，觀我朵頤，凶。
六二：顛頤，拂經，于丘頤，征凶。
六三：拂頤，貞凶，十年勿用，无攸利。
六四：顛頤，吉，虎視眈眈，其欲逐逐，无咎。
六五：拂經，居貞吉，不可涉大川。
上九：由頤，厲吉，利涉大川。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Shě ěr líng guī, guān wǒ duǒ yí, xiōng.
Liù èr: Diān yí, fú jīng, yú qiū yí, zhēng xiōng.
Liù sān: Fú yí, zhēn xiōng, shí nián wù yòng, wú yōu lì.
Liù sì: Diān yí, jí, hǔ shì dān dān, qí yù zhú zhú, wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Fú jīng, jū zhēn jí, bù kě shè dà chuān.
Shàng jiǔ: Yóu yí, lì jí, lì shè dà chuān.
lines_en: First line: You set aside your sacred tortoise and stare at my moving jaw. Misfortune.
Second line: Seeking nourishment upside down, departing from the norm; seeking it from the hill. Setting forth brings misfortune.
Third line: Rejecting nourishment. Perseverance brings misfortune. Do not act for ten years. Nothing favorable.
Fourth line: Seeking nourishment from below brings good fortune. The tiger stares intently, its desire unceasing. No blame.
Fifth line: Departing from the norm. Remaining persevering brings good fortune. One should not cross the great river.
Top line: The source of nourishment. Danger, but good fortune. Favorable to cross the great river.

judgment_pinyin: Dòng ráo, lì yǒu yōu wǎng, hēng.
judgment_en: The ridgepole sags. Favorable to go somewhere. Success.
lines_zh: 初六：藉用白茅，无咎。
九二：枯楊生稊，老夫得其女妻，无不利。
九三：棟橈，凶。
九四：棟隆，吉；有它吝。
九五：枯楊生華，老婦得士夫，无咎无譽。
上六：過涉滅頂，凶，无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Jí yòng bái máo, wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Kū yáng shēng tí, lǎo fū dé qí nǚ qī, wú bù lì.
Jiǔ sān: Dòng ráo, xiōng.
Jiǔ sì: Dòng lóng, jí; yǒu tā lìn.
Jiǔ wǔ: Kū yáng shēng huá, lǎo fù dé shì fū, wú jiù wú yù.
Shàng liù: Guò shè miè dǐng, xiōng, wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: A mat of white rushes beneath. No blame.
Second line: A withered willow sprouts new shoots; an old man takes a young wife. Nothing unfavorable.
Third line: The ridgepole sags. Misfortune.
Fourth line: The ridgepole is raised. Good fortune; other concerns bring humiliation.
Fifth line: A withered willow puts forth flowers; an old woman takes a young husband. No blame, no praise.
Top line: Wading too deep, the water goes over one's head. Misfortune, no blame.

judgment_zh: 習坎，有孚，維心亨，行有尚。
judgment_pinyin: Xí kǎn, yǒu fú, wéi xīn hēng, xíng yǒu shàng.
judgment_en: The abyss repeated. There is sincerity; the heart holds firm, success. Action brings esteem.
lines_zh: 初六：習坎，入于坎窞，凶。
九二：坎有險，求小得。
六三：來之坎坎，險且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。
六四：樽酒簋貳，用缶，納約自牖，終无咎。
九五：坎不盈，祗既平，无咎。
上六：係用徽纆，寘于叢棘，三歲不得，凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Xí kǎn, rù yú kǎn dàn, xiōng.
Jiǔ èr: Kǎn yǒu xiǎn, qiú xiǎo dé.
Liù sān: Lái zhī kǎn kǎn, xiǎn qiě zhěn, rù yú kǎn dàn, wù yòng.
Liù sì: Zūn jiǔ guǐ èr, yòng fǒu, nà yuē zì yǒu, zhōng wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Kǎn bù yíng, zhī jì píng, wú jiù.
Shàng liù: Xì yòng huī mò, zhì yú cóng jí, sān suì bù dé, xiōng.
lines_en: First line: The abyss repeated: falling into a pit within the abyss. Misfortune.
Second line: The abyss is dangerous. Seek small gains.
Third line: Coming and going, abyss upon abyss; danger, and deep. Falling into a pit within the abyss — do not act.
Fourth line: A jug of wine, a bowl of grain besides, in earthen vessels, passed in through the window. No blame in the end.
Fifth line: The abyss is not overflowing, only filled level. No blame.
Top line: Bound with cords and ropes, placed among thorn bushes. For three years no release. Misfortune.

judgment_pinyin: Lì zhēn, hēng. Chù pìn niú, jí.
judgment_en: Favorable perseverance. Success. Raising a cow brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初九：履錯然，敬之无咎。
六二：黃離，元吉。
九三：日昃之離，不鼓缶而歌，則大耋之嗟，凶。
九四：突如其來如，焚如，死如，棄如。
六五：出涕沱若，戚嗟若，吉。
上九：王用出征，有嘉折首，獲匪其醜，无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Lǚ cuò rán, jìng zhī wú jiù.
Liù èr: Huáng lí, yuán jí.
Jiǔ sān: Rì zè zhī lí, bù gǔ fǒu ér gē, zé dà dié zhī jiē, xiōng.
Jiǔ sì: Tū rú qí lái rú, fén rú, sǐ rú, qì rú.
Liù wǔ: Chū tì tuó ruò, qī jiē ruò, jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Wáng yòng chū zhēng, yǒu jiā zhé shǒu, huò fěi qí chǒu, wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: Footsteps in confusion. Be respectful, and no blame.
Second line: Yellow brightness. Supreme good fortune.
Third line: The brightness of the setting sun. Not beating the pot and singing, one laments old age. Misfortune.
Fourth line: Suddenly it comes — it blazes, it dies, it is cast away.
Fifth line: Tears in floods, sighing and lamenting. Good fortune.
Top line: The king sends him to march forth. He wins by taking the chiefs, not their followers. No blame.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng, lì zhēn, qǔ nǚ jí.
judgment_en: Success. Favorable perseverance. Taking a wife brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六，咸其拇。
六二，咸其腓，凶，居吉。
九三，咸其股，執其隨，往吝。
九四，貞吉，悔亡，憧憧往來，朋從爾思。
九五，咸其脢，无悔。
上六，咸其輔頰舌。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù, xián qí mǔ.
Liù èr, xián qí féi, xiōng, jū jí.
Jiǔ sān, xián qí gǔ, zhí qí suí, wǎng lìn.
Jiǔ sì, zhēn jí, huǐ wáng, chōng chōng wǎng lái, péng cóng ěr sī.
Jiǔ wǔ, xián qí méi, wú huǐ.
Shàng liù, xián qí fǔ jiá shé.
lines_en: First line: Influence in the big toe.
Second line: Influence in the calves. Misfortune; staying put brings good fortune.
Third line: Influence in the thighs, holding to what follows. Going on brings humiliation.
Fourth line: Perseverance brings good fortune; regret vanishes. Coming and going restlessly, only friends follow your thoughts.
Fifth line: Influence in the back. No regret.
Top line: Influence in the jaws, cheeks and tongue.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng, wú jiù, lì zhēn, lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
judgment_en: Success. No blame. Favorable perseverance. Favorable to go somewhere.
lines_zh: 初六：浚恆，貞凶，无攸利。
九二：悔亡。
九三：不恆其德，或承之羞，貞吝。
九四：田无禽。
六五：恆其德，貞，婦人吉，夫子凶。
上六：振恆，凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Jùn héng, zhēn xiōng, wú yōu lì.
Jiǔ èr: Huǐ wáng.
Jiǔ sān: Bù héng qí dé, huò chéng zhī xiū, zhēn lìn.
Jiǔ sì: Tián wú qín.
Liù wǔ: Héng qí dé, zhēn, fù rén jí, fū zǐ xiōng.
Shàng liù: Zhèn héng, xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Seeking constancy too deeply. Perseverance brings misfortune. Nothing favorable.
Second line: Regret vanishes.
Third line: Not constant in virtue, one may meet with disgrace. Perseverance brings humiliation.
Fourth line: No game in the field.
Fifth line: Constant in virtue, persevering: good fortune for a woman, misfortune for a man.
Top line: Restless constancy. Misfortune.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng, xiǎo lì zhēn.
judgment_en: Success. Small gains through perseverance.
lines_zh: 初六：遯尾，厲，勿用有攸往。
六二：執之用黃牛之革，莫之勝說。
九三：係遯，有疾厲，畜臣妾吉。
九四：好遯，君子吉，小人否。
九五：嘉遯，貞吉。
上九：肥遯，无不利。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Dùn wěi, lì, wù yòng yǒu yōu wǎng.
Liù èr: Zhí zhī yòng huáng niú zhī gé, mò zhī shèng shuō.
Jiǔ sān: Xì dùn, yǒu jí lì, chù chén qiè jí.
Jiǔ sì: Hǎo dùn, jūn zǐ jí, xiǎo rén fǒu.
Jiǔ wǔ: Jiā dùn, zhēn jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Féi dùn, wú bù lì.
lines_en: First line: Retreating at the tail. Danger. Do not go anywhere.
Second line: Bound with yellow oxhide; no one can break it.
Third line: A retreat held back. Illness and danger. Keeping servants and maids brings good fortune.
Fourth line: Willing retreat. Good fortune for the noble one; not for the petty person.
Fifth line: Fine retreat. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Top line: Ample retreat. Nothing unfavorable.

judgment_pinyin: Lì zhēn.
judgment_en: Favorable perseverance.
lines_zh: 初九：壯于趾，征凶，有孚。
九二：貞吉。
九三：小人用壯，君子用罔，貞厲。羝羊觸藩，羸其角。
九四：貞吉悔亡，藩決不羸，壯于大輿之輹。
六五：喪羊于易，无悔。
上六：羝羊觸藩，不能退，不能遂，无攸利，艱則吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Zhuàng yú zhǐ, zhēng xiōng, yǒu fú.
Jiǔ èr: Zhēn jí.
Jiǔ sān: Xiǎo rén yòng zhuàng, jūn zǐ yòng wǎng, zhēn lì. Dī yáng chù fān, léi qí jiǎo.
Jiǔ sì: Zhēn jí huǐ wáng, fān jué bù léi, zhuàng yú dà yú zhī fù.
Liù wǔ: Sàng yáng yú yì, wú huǐ.
Shàng liù: Dī yáng chù fān, bù néng tuì, bù néng suì, wú yōu lì, jiān zé jí.
lines_en: First line: Strength in the toes. Setting forth brings misfortune; this is certain.
Second line: Perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: The petty person uses strength; the noble one does not. Perseverance brings danger. A ram butts a fence and entangles its horns.
Fourth line: Perseverance brings good fortune; regret vanishes. The fence opens, no entanglement. Strength like the axle of a great cart.
Fifth line: Losing the ram at Yi. No regret.
Top line: A ram butts a fence; it can neither retreat nor advance. Nothing favorable; hardship brings good fortune.

judgment_zh: 康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接。
judgment_pinyin: Kāng hóu yòng xī mǎ fān shù, zhòu rì sān jiē.
judgment_en: The Marquis of Kang is given many horses, and is received three times in one day.
lines_zh: 初六：晉如，摧如，貞吉。罔孚，裕无咎。
六二：晉如，愁如，貞吉。受茲介福，于其王母。
六三：眾允，悔亡。
九四：晉如碩鼠，貞厲。
六五：悔亡，失得勿恤，往吉，无不利。
上九：晉其角，維用伐邑，厲吉无咎，貞吝。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Jìn rú, cuī rú, zhēn jí. Wǎng fú, yù wú jiù.
Liù èr: Jìn rú, chóu rú, zhēn jí. Shòu zī jiè fú, yú qí wáng mǔ.
Liù sān: Zhòng yǔn, huǐ wáng.
Jiǔ sì: Jìn rú shuò shǔ, zhēn lì.
Liù wǔ: Huǐ wáng, shī dé wù xù, wǎng jí, wú bù lì.
Shàng jiǔ: Jìn qí jiǎo, wéi yòng fá yì, lì jí wú jiù, zhēn lìn.
lines_en: First line: Advancing, yet held back. Perseverance brings good fortune. If not trusted, stay at ease: no blame.
Second line: Advancing, yet sorrowful. Perseverance brings good fortune. One receives great blessing from one's grandmother.
Third line: All agree. Regret vanishes.
Fourth line: Advancing like a big rat. Perseverance brings danger.
Fifth line: Regret vanishes. Do not worry over loss or gain. Going brings good fortune; nothing unfavorable.
Top line: Advancing with the horns, used only to punish one's own city. Danger, good fortune, no blame; perseverance brings humiliation.

judgment_pinyin: Lì jiān zhēn.
judgment_en: Favorable to persevere in hardship.
lines_zh: 初九：明夷于飛，垂其翼。君子于行，三日不食，有攸往，主人有言。
六二：明夷，夷于左股，用拯馬壯，吉。
九三：明夷于南狩，得其大首，不可疾貞。
六四：入于左腹，獲明夷之心，出于門庭。
六五：箕子之明夷，利貞。
上六：不明晦，初登于天，後入于地。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Míng yí yú fēi, chuí qí yì. Jūn zǐ yú xíng, sān rì bù shí, yǒu yōu wǎng, zhǔ rén yǒu yán.
Liù èr: Míng yí, yí yú zuǒ gǔ, yòng zhěng mǎ zhuàng, jí.
Jiǔ sān: Míng yí yú nán shòu, dé qí dà shǒu, bù kě jí zhēn.
Liù sì: Rù yú zuǒ fù, huò míng yí zhī xīn, chū yú mén tíng.
Liù wǔ: Jī zi zhī míng yí, lì zhēn.
Shàng liù: Bù míng huì, chū dēng yú tiān, hòu rù yú dì.
lines_en: First line: The light dims in flight; it lowers its wings. The noble one travels and does not eat for three days. Wherever he goes, the host talks.
Second line: The light dims; wounded in the left thigh. Rescue with a strong horse. Good fortune.
Third line: The light dims during the southern hunt; the great chief is captured. Do not be hasty in perseverance.
Fourth line: Entering the left side of the belly, one grasps the heart of the darkening, and leaves through the gate.
Fifth line: The darkening of the light, as with Prince Ji. Favorable perseverance.
Top line: Not bright but dark. First he rose to heaven, then he sank into the earth.

judgment_pinyin: Lì nǚ zhēn.
judgment_en: Favorable is a woman's perseverance.
lines_zh: 初九：閑有家，悔亡。
六二：无攸遂，在中饋，貞吉。
九三：家人嗃嗃，悔厲吉；婦子嘻嘻，終吝。
六四：富家，大吉。
九五：王假有家，勿恤，往吉。
上九：有孚威如，終吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Xián yǒu jiā, huǐ wáng.
Liù èr: Wú yōu suì, zài zhōng kuì, zhēn jí.
Jiǔ sān: Jiā rén hè hè, huǐ lì jí; fù zi xī xī, zhōng lìn.
Liù sì: Fù jiā, dà jí.
Jiǔ wǔ: Wáng jiǎ yǒu jiā, wù xù, wǎng jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Yǒu fú wēi rú, zhōng jí.
lines_en: First line: Firm rules within the household. Regret vanishes.
Second line: She does not follow her own whims; she tends to the food within. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: Strictness in the household: regret and danger, but good fortune. Wife and children giggling: humiliation in the end.
Fourth line: Enriching the household. Great good fortune.
Fifth line: The king comes to his household. Do not worry. Good fortune.
Top line: Sincerity that commands respect. Good fortune in the end.

judgment_pinyin: Xiǎo shì jí.
judgment_en: In small matters, good fortune.
lines_zh: 初九：悔亡，喪馬勿逐，自復；見惡人无咎。
九二：遇主于巷，无咎。
六三：見輿曳，其牛掣，其人天且劓，无初有終。
九四：睽孤，遇元夫，交孚，厲无咎。
六五：悔亡，厥宗噬膚，往何咎。
上九：睽孤，見豕負塗，載鬼一車，先張之弧，後說之弧，匪寇婚媾，往遇雨則吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Huǐ wáng, sàng mǎ wù zhú, zì fù; jiàn è rén wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Yù zhǔ yú xiàng, wú jiù.
Liù sān: Jiàn yú yè, qí niú chè, qí rén tiān qiě yì, wú chū yǒu zhōng.
Jiǔ sì: Kuí gū, yù yuán fū, jiāo fú, lì wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Huǐ wáng, jué zōng shì fū, wǎng hé jiù.
Shàng jiǔ: Kuí gū, jiàn shǐ fù tú, zài guǐ yī chē, xiān zhāng zhī hú, hòu shuō zhī hú, fěi kòu hūn gòu, wǎng yù yǔ zé jí.
lines_en: First line: Regret vanishes. Lose your horse, do not chase it; it returns by itself. Meeting evil people: no blame.
Second line: Meeting one's lord in a narrow lane. No blame.
Third line: One sees the cart dragged back, the ox held fast, the man branded and his nose cut off. No good beginning, but a good end.
Fourth line: Isolated by opposition, he meets a worthy man; they trust each other. Danger, no blame.
Fifth line: Regret vanishes. His kinsman bites through the skin. Going on, how could there be blame?

Top line: Isolated by opposition, he sees a pig covered in mud, a cart full of ghosts. First he draws his bow, then lays it down. Not a robber — a suitor. Going on and meeting rain brings good fortune.

judgment_zh: 利西南，不利東北；利見大人，貞吉。
judgment_pinyin: Lì xī nán, bù lì dōng běi; lì jiàn dà rén, zhēn jí.
judgment_en: Favorable in the southwest; not favorable in the northeast. Favorable to see the great man. Perseverance brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六：往蹇，來譽。
六二：王臣蹇蹇，匪躬之故。
九三：往蹇來反。
六四：往蹇來連。
九五：大蹇朋來。
上六：往蹇來碩，吉；利見大人。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Wǎng jiǎn, lái yù.
Liù èr: Wáng chén jiǎn jiǎn, fěi gōng zhī gù.
Jiǔ sān: Wǎng jiǎn lái fǎn.
Liù sì: Wǎng jiǎn lái lián.
Jiǔ wǔ: Dà jiǎn péng lái.
Shàng liù: Wǎng jiǎn lái shuò, jí; lì jiàn dà rén.
lines_en: First line: Going brings obstruction; coming back brings praise.
Second line: The king's servant meets obstruction upon obstruction, not for his own sake.
Third line: Going brings obstruction, so he turns back.
Fourth line: Going brings obstruction; coming back brings allies.
Fifth line: In great obstruction, friends come.
Top line: Going brings obstruction; coming back brings greatness. Good fortune. Favorable to see the great man.

judgment_zh: 利西南，无所往，其來復吉。有攸往，夙吉。
judgment_pinyin: Lì xī nán, wú suǒ wǎng, qí lái fù jí. Yǒu yōu wǎng, sù jí.
judgment_en: Favorable in the southwest. With nowhere to go, returning brings good fortune. With somewhere to go, going early brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六：无咎。
九二：田獲三狐，得黃矢，貞吉。
六三：負且乘，致寇至，貞吝。
九四：解而拇，朋至斯孚。
六五：君子維有解，吉；有孚于小人。
上六：公用射隼于高墉之上，獲之，无不利。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Tián huò sān hú, dé huáng shǐ, zhēn jí.
Liù sān: Fù qiě chéng, zhì kòu zhì, zhēn lìn.
Jiǔ sì: Jiě ér mǔ, péng zhì sī fú.
Liù wǔ: Jūn zǐ wéi yǒu jiě, jí; yǒu fú yú xiǎo rén.
Shàng liù: Gōng yòng shè sǔn yú gāo yōng zhī shàng, huò zhī, wú bù lì.
lines_en: First line: No blame.
Second line: In the field he catches three foxes and gains a yellow arrow. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: Carrying a load while riding a carriage invites robbers. Perseverance brings humiliation.
Fourth line: Free yourself from your big toe; then friends come, and there is trust.
Fifth line: Only the noble one can find release. Good fortune. He shows his sincerity even to petty people.
Top line: The duke shoots a hawk on a high wall and hits it. Nothing unfavorable.

judgment_zh: 有孚，元吉，无咎，可貞，利有攸往。曷之用，二簋可用享。
judgment_pinyin: Yǒu fú, yuán jí, wú jiù, kě zhēn, lì yǒu yōu wǎng. Hé zhī yòng, èr guǐ kě yòng xiǎng.
judgment_en: There is sincerity: supreme good fortune, no blame. One can persevere; favorable to go somewhere. What is to be used? Two simple bowls are enough for the offering.
lines_zh: 初九：巳事遄往，无咎，酌損之。
九二：利貞，征凶，弗損，益之。
六三：三人行，則損一人；一人行，則得其友。
六四：損其疾，使遄有喜，无咎。
六五：或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，元吉。
上九：弗損益之，无咎，貞吉，有攸往，得臣无家。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Sì shì chuán wǎng, wú jiù, zhuó sǔn zhī.
Jiǔ èr: Lì zhēn, zhēng xiōng, fú sǔn, yì zhī.
Liù sān: Sān rén xíng, zé sǔn yī rén; yī rén xíng, zé dé qí yǒu.
Liù sì: Sǔn qí jí, shǐ chuán yǒu xǐ, wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Huò yì zhī, shí péng zhī guī fú kè wéi, yuán jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Fú sǔn yì zhī, wú jiù, zhēn jí, yǒu yōu wǎng, dé chén wú jiā.
lines_en: First line: When your work is done, go quickly. No blame. Weigh how much to decrease.
Second line: Favorable perseverance. Setting forth brings misfortune. Without decreasing, one increases.
Third line: Three walking together lose one; one walking alone finds a companion.
Fourth line: Decreasing one's ills; quick action brings joy. No blame.
Fifth line: Someone increases him; ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Supreme good fortune.
Top line: Increasing without decreasing. No blame. Perseverance brings good fortune. Favorable to go somewhere. He gains servants, not a household of his own.

judgment_pinyin: Lì yǒu yōu wǎng, lì shè dà chuān.
judgment_en: Favorable to go somewhere. Favorable to cross the great river.
lines_zh: 初九：利用為大作，元吉，无咎。
六二：或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，永貞吉。王用享于帝，吉。
六三：益之用凶事，无咎。有孚中行，告公用圭。
六四：中行，告公從。利用為依遷國。
九五：有孚惠心，勿問元吉。有孚惠我德。
上九：莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Lì yòng wèi dà zuò, yuán jí, wú jiù.
Liù èr: Huò yì zhī, shí péng zhī guī fú kè wéi, yǒng zhēn jí. Wáng yòng xiǎng yú dì, jí.
Liù sān: Yì zhī yòng xiōng shì, wú jiù. Yǒu fú zhōng háng, gào gōng yòng guī.
Liù sì: Zhōng háng, gào gōng cóng. Lì yòng wèi yī qiān guó.
Jiǔ wǔ: Yǒu fú huì xīn, wù wèn yuán jí. Yǒu fú huì wǒ dé.
Shàng jiǔ: Mò yì zhī, huò jī zhī, lì xīn wù héng, xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Favorable to undertake great works. Supreme good fortune; no blame.
Second line: Someone increases him; ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Lasting perseverance brings good fortune. The king makes an offering to the Lord on High. Good fortune.
Third line: Increased through misfortune: no blame. With sincerity, walking the middle way, report to the duke with a jade tablet.
Fourth line: Walking the middle way, report to the duke, and he follows. Favorable to be relied on in moving the capital.
Fifth line: With sincerity and a kind heart, no need to ask: supreme good fortune. Sincerity rewards my virtue with kindness.
Top line: No one increases him; someone may strike him. He does not keep his heart steady. Misfortune.

judgment_zh: 揚于王庭，孚號，有厲，告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。
judgment_pinyin: Yáng yú wáng tíng, fú hào, yǒu lì, gào zì yì, bù lì jí róng, lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
judgment_en: Proclaim it at the king's court; call out in sincerity — there is danger. Inform your own city; not favorable to take up arms. Favorable to go somewhere.
lines_zh: 初九：壯于前趾，往不勝為咎。
九二：惕號，莫夜有戎，勿恤。
九三：壯于頄，有凶。君子夬夬，獨行，遇雨，若濡，有慍，无咎。
九四：臀无膚，其行次且。牽羊悔亡，聞言不信。
九五：莧陸夬夬，中行无咎。
上六：无號，終有凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Zhuàng yú qián zhǐ, wǎng bù shèng wèi jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Tì hào, mò yè yǒu róng, wù xù.
Jiǔ sān: Zhuàng yú kuí, yǒu xiōng. Jūn zǐ guài guài, dú xíng, yù yǔ, ruò rú, yǒu yùn, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sì: Tún wú fū, qí xíng cì qiě. Qiān yáng huǐ wáng, wén yán bù xìn.
Jiǔ wǔ: Xiàn lù guài guài, zhōng háng wú jiù.
Shàng liù: Wú hào, zhōng yǒu xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Strength in the forward toes. Going without winning is a fault.
Second line: Alarmed cries; armed men at night. Do not worry.
Third line: Strength in the cheekbones brings misfortune. The noble one is firmly resolved; walking alone, he meets rain and gets wet. There is resentment, but no blame.
Fourth line: No skin on the buttocks; walking is hard. Led like a sheep, regret would vanish, but hearing these words he does not believe them.
Fifth line: Uprooting weeds with firm resolve. Walking the middle way: no blame.
Top line: No cry of warning. Misfortune in the end.

judgment_pinyin: Nǚ zhuàng, wù yòng qǔ nǚ.
judgment_en: The woman is strong. Do not marry such a woman.
lines_zh: 初六：繫于金柅，貞吉，有攸往，見凶，羸豕孚蹢躅。
九二：包有魚，无咎，不利賓。
九三：臀无膚，其行次且，厲，无大咎。
九四：包无魚，起凶。
九五：以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天。
上九：姤其角，吝，无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Xì yú jīn nǐ, zhēn jí, yǒu yōu wǎng, jiàn xiōng, léi shǐ fú dí zhú.
Jiǔ èr: Bāo yǒu yú, wú jiù, bù lì bīn.
Jiǔ sān: Tún wú fū, qí xíng cì qiě, lì, wú dà jiù.
Jiǔ sì: Bāo wú yú, qǐ xiōng.
Jiǔ wǔ: Yǐ qǐ bāo guā, hán zhāng, yǒu yǔn zì tiān.
Shàng jiǔ: Gòu qí jiǎo, lìn, wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: Fastened to a metal brake. Perseverance brings good fortune. Going anywhere, one meets misfortune. A lean pig is sure to pace restlessly.
Second line: Fish in the wrapper. No blame. Not favorable for guests.
Third line: No skin on the buttocks; walking is hard. Danger, but no great blame.
Fourth line: No fish in the wrapper. Rising up brings misfortune.
Fifth line: A melon wrapped in willow leaves. Hidden brilliance. It falls from Heaven.
Top line: Meeting with the horns. Humiliation, no blame.

judgment_zh: 亨。王假有廟，利見大人，亨，利貞。用大牲吉，利有攸往。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Wáng jiǎ yǒu miào, lì jiàn dà rén, hēng, lì zhēn. Yòng dà shēng jí, lì yǒu yōu wǎng.
judgment_en: Success. The king approaches his temple. Favorable to see the great man; success, favorable perseverance. Offering large animals brings good fortune. Favorable to go somewhere.
lines_zh: 初六：有孚不終，乃亂乃萃，若號一握為笑，勿恤，往无咎。
六二：引吉，无咎，孚乃利用禴。
六三：萃如，嗟如，无攸利，往无咎，小吝。
九四：大吉，无咎。
九五：萃有位，无咎。匪孚，元永貞，悔亡。
上六：齎咨涕洟，无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Yǒu fú bù zhōng, nǎi luàn nǎi cuì, ruò hào yī wò wèi xiào, wù xù, wǎng wú jiù.
Liù èr: Yǐn jí, wú jiù, fú nǎi lì yòng yuè.
Liù sān: Cuì rú, jiē rú, wú yōu lì, wǎng wú jiù, xiǎo lìn.
Jiǔ sì: Dà jí, wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Cuì yǒu wèi, wú jiù. Fěi fú, yuán yǒng zhēn, huǐ wáng.
Shàng liù: Jī zī tì tì, wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: Sincere but not to the end: confusion, then gathering. If you cry out, one clasp of the hand turns it to laughter. Do not worry; going on, no blame.
Second line: Being drawn brings good fortune; no blame. With sincerity, even a simple offering is favorable.
Third line: Gathering with sighs. Nothing favorable. Going on, no blame; slight humiliation.
Fourth line: Great good fortune. No blame.
Fifth line: Gathering in a position of rank. No blame. If not trusted, supreme lasting perseverance makes regret vanish.
Top line: Sighing and lamenting, tears flowing. No blame.

judgment_zh: 元亨，用見大人，勿恤，南征吉。
judgment_pinyin: Yuán hēng, yòng jiàn dà rén, wù xù, nán zhēng jí.
judgment_en: Supreme success. Go to see the great man; do not worry. Marching south brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六：允升，大吉。
九二：孚乃利用禴，无咎。
九三：升虛邑。
六四：王用亨于岐山，吉无咎。
六五：貞吉，升階。
上六：冥升，利于不息之貞。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Yǔn shēng, dà jí.
Jiǔ èr: Fú nǎi lì yòng yuè, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sān: Shēng xū yì.
Liù sì: Wáng yòng hēng yú qí shān, jí wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Zhēn jí, shēng jiē.
Shàng liù: Míng shēng, lì yú bù xī zhī zhēn.
lines_en: First line: Trusted rising. Great good fortune.
Second line: With sincerity, even a simple offering is favorable. No blame.
Third line: Rising into an empty city.
Fourth line: The king makes an offering on Mount Qi. Good fortune; no blame.
Fifth line: Perseverance brings good fortune. Rising step by step.
Top line: Rising in darkness. Favorable is unceasing perseverance.

judgment_zh: 亨，貞，大人吉，无咎，有言不信。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng, zhēn, dà rén jí, wú jiù, yǒu yán bù xìn.
judgment_en: Success. Perseverance. Good fortune for the great man; no blame. Words are not believed.
lines_zh: 初六：臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三歲不覿。
九二：困于酒食，朱紱方來，利用享祀，征凶，无咎。
六三：困于石，據于蒺蔾，入于其宮，不見其妻，凶。
九四：來徐徐，困于金車，吝，有終。
九五：劓刖，困于赤紱，乃徐有說，利用祭祀。
上六：困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰動悔。有悔，征吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Tún kùn yú zhū mù, rù yú yōu gǔ, sān suì bù dí.
Jiǔ èr: Kùn yú jiǔ shí, zhū fú fāng lái, lì yòng xiǎng sì, zhēng xiōng, wú jiù.
Liù sān: Kùn yú shí, jù yú jí lí, rù yú qí gōng, bù jiàn qí qī, xiōng.
Jiǔ sì: Lái xú xú, kùn yú jīn chē, lìn, yǒu zhōng.
Jiǔ wǔ: Yì yuè, kùn yú chì fú, nǎi xú yǒu shuō, lì yòng jì sì.
Shàng liù: Kùn yú gé lěi, yú niè wù, yuē dòng huǐ. Yǒu huǐ, zhēng jí.
lines_en: First line: Sitting oppressed under a tree stump, he enters a dark valley; for three years he sees no one.
Second line: Oppressed amid wine and food. The red knee bands of office are coming. Favorable to make offerings. Setting forth brings misfortune; no blame.
Third line: Oppressed by stone, leaning on thorns. He enters his house and does not see his wife. Misfortune.
Fourth line: He comes slowly, oppressed in a metal carriage. Humiliation, but a good end.
Fifth line: Nose and feet cut off; oppressed by the red knee bands. Joy comes slowly. Favorable to make offerings.
Top line: Oppressed by creeping vines, tottering. He says, 'Moving brings regret.' Having regret, setting forth brings good fortune.

judgment_zh: 改邑不改井，无喪无得，往來井井。汔至，亦未繘井，羸其瓶，凶。
judgment_pinyin: Gǎi yì bù gǎi jǐng, wú sàng wú dé, wǎng lái jǐng jǐng. Qì zhì, yì wèi yù jǐng, léi qí píng, xiōng.
judgment_en: The town may change, but not the well. Nothing lost, nothing gained; people come and go and draw from it. If the rope nearly reaches the water but does not, or the jar breaks, misfortune.
lines_zh: 初六：井泥不食，舊井无禽。
九二：井谷射鮒，瓮敝漏。
九三：井渫不食，為我心惻，可用汲，王明，並受其福。
六四：井甃，无咎。
九五：井冽，寒泉食。
上六：井收勿幕，有孚元吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Jǐng ní bù shí, jiù jǐng wú qín.
Jiǔ èr: Jǐng gǔ shè fù, wèng bì lòu.
Jiǔ sān: Jǐng xiè bù shí, wèi wǒ xīn cè, kě yòng jí, wáng míng, bìng shòu qí fú.
Liù sì: Jǐng zhòu, wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Jǐng liè, hán quán shí.
Shàng liù: Jǐng shōu wù mù, yǒu fú yuán jí.
lines_en: First line: A muddy well is not drunk from; no birds come to an old well.
Second line: At the well's bottom, one shoots small fish; the jar is broken and leaks.
Third line: The well is cleaned, but no one drinks; my heart is grieved. It could be drawn from. If the king were wise, all would share the blessing.
Fourth line: The well is lined with brick. No blame.
Fifth line: The well is clear; its cold spring water is drunk.
Top line: The well is drawn from; do not cover it. There is sincerity. Supreme good fortune.

judgment_zh: 巳日乃孚，元亨利貞，悔亡。
judgment_pinyin: Sì rì nǎi fú, yuán hēng lì zhēn, huǐ wáng.
judgment_en: On the day of completion one is trusted. Supreme success, favorable perseverance. Regret vanishes.
lines_zh: 初九：鞏用黃牛之革。
六二：巳日乃革之，征吉，无咎。
九三：征凶，貞厲，革言三就，有孚。
九四：悔亡，有孚改命，吉。
九五：大人虎變，未占有孚。
上六：君子豹變，小人革面，征凶，居貞吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Gǒng yòng huáng niú zhī gé.
Liù èr: Sì rì nǎi gé zhī, zhēng jí, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sān: Zhēng xiōng, zhēn lì, gé yán sān jiù, yǒu fú.
Jiǔ sì: Huǐ wáng, yǒu fú gǎi mìng, jí.
Jiǔ wǔ: Dà rén hǔ biàn, wèi zhàn yǒu fú.
Shàng liù: Jūn zǐ bào biàn, xiǎo rén gé miàn, zhēng xiōng, jū zhēn jí.
lines_en: First line: Bound with yellow oxhide.
Second line: On the day of completion, carry out the change. Setting forth brings good fortune. No blame.
Third line: Setting forth brings misfortune. Perseverance brings danger. When talk of change has come round three times, there is trust.
Fourth line: Regret vanishes. With sincerity, changing the mandate brings good fortune.
Fifth line: The great man changes like a tiger. Even before divining, he is trusted.
Top line: The noble one changes like a leopard; the petty person changes only his face. Setting forth brings misfortune; remaining persevering brings good fortune.

judgment_pinyin: Yuán jí, hēng.
judgment_en: Supreme good fortune. Success.
lines_zh: 初六：鼎顛趾，利出否，得妾以其子，无咎。
九二：鼎有實，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。
九三：鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨虧悔，終吉。
九四：鼎折足，覆公餗，其形渥，凶。
六五：鼎黃耳，金鉉，利貞。
上九：鼎玉鉉，大吉，无不利。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Dǐng diān zhǐ, lì chū fǒu, dé qiè yǐ qí zi, wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Dǐng yǒu shí, wǒ chóu yǒu jí, bù wǒ néng jí, jí.
Jiǔ sān: Dǐng ěr gé, qí xíng sāi, zhì gāo bù shí, fāng yǔ kuī huǐ, zhōng jí.
Jiǔ sì: Dǐng zhé zú, fù gōng sù, qí xíng wò, xiōng.
Liù wǔ: Dǐng huáng ěr, jīn xuàn, lì zhēn.
Shàng jiǔ: Dǐng yù xuàn, dà jí, wú bù lì.
lines_en: First line: The cauldron is upturned on its legs; favorable for clearing out the stale. Taking a concubine for her son. No blame.
Second line: The cauldron is full. My rival is ill and cannot reach me. Good fortune.
Third line: The cauldron's ears are altered; its movement is blocked. The pheasant fat is not eaten. When rain comes, regret fades. Good fortune in the end.
Fourth line: The cauldron's leg breaks; the duke's meal is spilled, and he is soaked. Misfortune.
Fifth line: The cauldron has yellow ears and a metal carrying rod. Favorable perseverance.
Top line: The cauldron has a jade carrying rod. Great good fortune; nothing unfavorable.

judgment_zh: 亨。震來虩虩，笑言啞啞。震驚百里，不喪匕鬯。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Zhèn lái xì xì, xiào yán yǎ yǎ. Zhèn jīng bǎi lǐ, bù sàng bǐ chàng.
judgment_en: Success. Thunder comes, fearful and trembling; then laughter and talk. Thunder startles for a hundred miles, yet he does not drop the ritual ladle and wine.
lines_zh: 初九：震來虩虩，後笑言啞啞，吉。
六二：震來厲，億喪貝，躋于九陵，勿逐，七日得。
六三：震蘇蘇，震行无眚。
九四：震遂泥。
六五：震往來厲，億无喪，有事。
上六：震索索，視矍矍，征凶。震不于其躬，于其鄰，无咎。婚媾有言。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Zhèn lái xì xì, hòu xiào yán yǎ yǎ, jí.
Liù èr: Zhèn lái lì, yì sàng bèi, jī yú jiǔ líng, wù zhú, qī rì dé.
Liù sān: Zhèn sū sū, zhèn xíng wú shěng.
Jiǔ sì: Zhèn suì ní.
Liù wǔ: Zhèn wǎng lái lì, yì wú sàng, yǒu shì.
Shàng liù: Zhèn suǒ suǒ, shì jué jué, zhēng xiōng. Zhèn bù yú qí gōng, yú qí lín, wú jiù. Hūn gòu yǒu yán.
lines_en: First line: Thunder comes, fearful and trembling; afterward laughter and talk. Good fortune.
Second line: Thunder comes with danger; great losses of treasure. Climb the nine hills; do not chase after it; in seven days it is regained.
Third line: Thunder leaves one shaken; moving on under thunder, no harm.
Fourth line: Thunder gets stuck in the mud.
Fifth line: Thunder comes and goes, with danger. Yet nothing is lost; there is work to do.
Top line: Thunder brings trembling and darting glances. Setting forth brings misfortune. If it strikes not oneself but one's neighbor, no blame. There is talk about marriage.

judgment_zh: 艮其背，不獲其身，行其庭，不見其人，无咎。
judgment_pinyin: Gěn qí bèi, bù huò qí shēn, xíng qí tíng, bù jiàn qí rén, wú jiù.
judgment_en: Keeping the back still, he no longer feels his body. Walking in his courtyard, he does not see his people. No blame.
lines_zh: 初六：艮其趾，无咎，利永貞。
六二：艮其腓，不拯其隨，其心不快。
九三：艮其限，列其夤，厲薰心。
六四：艮其身，无咎。
六五：艮其輔，言有序，悔亡。
上九：敦艮，吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Gěn qí zhǐ, wú jiù, lì yǒng zhēn.
Liù èr: Gěn qí féi, bù zhěng qí suí, qí xīn bù kuài.
Jiǔ sān: Gěn qí xiàn, liè qí yín, lì xūn xīn.
Liù sì: Gěn qí shēn, wú jiù.
Liù wǔ: Gěn qí fǔ, yán yǒu xù, huǐ wáng.
Shàng jiǔ: Dūn gěn, jí.
lines_en: First line: Keeping the toes still. No blame. Favorable is lasting perseverance.
Second line: Keeping the calves still. He cannot rescue the one he follows; his heart is not glad.
Third line: Keeping the waist still, the spine rigid. Danger; the heart burns.
Fourth line: Keeping the trunk still. No blame.
Fifth line: Keeping the jaws still; words are in order. Regret vanishes.
Top line: Steadfast stillness. Good fortune.

judgment_pinyin: Nǚ guī jí, lì zhēn.
judgment_en: The maiden marries. Good fortune. Favorable perseverance.
lines_zh: 初六：鴻漸于干，小子厲，有言，无咎。
六二：鴻漸于磐，飲食衎衎，吉。
九三：鴻漸于陸，夫征不復，婦孕不育，凶；利禦寇。
六四：鴻漸于木，或得其桷，无咎。
九五：鴻漸于陵，婦三歲不孕，終莫之勝，吉。
上九：鴻漸于陸，其羽可用為儀，吉。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Hóng jiàn yú gàn, xiǎo zi lì, yǒu yán, wú jiù.
Liù èr: Hóng jiàn yú pán, yǐn shí kàn kàn, jí.
Jiǔ sān: Hóng jiàn yú lù, fū zhēng bù fù, fù yùn bù yù, xiōng; lì yù kòu.
Liù sì: Hóng jiàn yú mù, huò dé qí jué, wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Hóng jiàn yú líng, fù sān suì bù yùn, zhōng mò zhī shèng, jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Hóng jiàn yú lù, qí yǔ kě yòng wèi yí, jí.
lines_en: First line: The wild goose gradually reaches the shore. The young son is in danger; there is gossip. No blame.
Second line: The wild goose gradually reaches the rock. Eating and drinking in harmony. Good fortune.
Third line: The wild goose gradually reaches the high plain. The husband goes off and does not return; the wife conceives but does not give birth. Misfortune. Favorable to repel raiders.
Fourth line: The wild goose gradually reaches the tree; perhaps it finds a flat branch. No blame.
Fifth line: The wild goose gradually reaches the hilltop. For three years the wife does not conceive; in the end nothing prevails against her. Good fortune.
Top line: The wild goose gradually reaches the high plain. Its feathers can be used in the rites. Good fortune.

judgment_pinyin: Zhēng xiōng, wú yōu lì.
judgment_en: Setting forth brings misfortune. Nothing favorable.
lines_zh: 初九：歸妹以娣，跛能履，征吉。
九二：眇能視，利幽人之貞。
六三：歸妹以須，反歸以娣。
九四：歸妹愆期，遲歸有時。
六五：帝乙歸妹，其君之袂，不如其娣之袂良，月幾望，吉。
上六：女承筐无實，士刲羊无血，无攸利。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Guī mèi yǐ dì, bǒ néng lǚ, zhēng jí.
Jiǔ èr: Miǎo néng shì, lì yōu rén zhī zhēn.
Liù sān: Guī mèi yǐ xū, fǎn guī yǐ dì.
Jiǔ sì: Guī mèi qiān qī, chí guī yǒu shí.
Liù wǔ: Dì yǐ guī mèi, qí jūn zhī mèi, bù rú qí dì zhī mèi liáng, yuè jǐ wàng, jí.
Shàng liù: Nǚ chéng kuāng wú shí, shì kuī yáng wú xuè, wú yōu lì.
lines_en: First line: The maiden marries as a junior wife. The lame can walk. Setting forth brings good fortune.
Second line: The one-eyed can see. Favorable is the perseverance of a recluse.
Third line: The maiden marries as a servant; she returns and marries as a junior wife.
Fourth line: The maiden delays the wedding; a late marriage comes in its time.
Fifth line: Emperor Yi gives his younger sister in marriage. The bride's sleeves are not as fine as those of the junior wife. The moon is nearly full. Good fortune.
Top line: The woman holds a basket with nothing in it; the man cuts the sheep, but no blood flows. Nothing favorable.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng, wáng jiǎ zhī, wù yōu, yí rì zhōng.
judgment_en: Success. The king reaches abundance. Do not worry; be like the sun at midday.
lines_zh: 初九：遇其配主，雖旬无咎，往有尚。
六二：豐其蔀，日中見斗，往得疑疾，有孚發若，吉。
九三：豐其沛，日中見沬，折其右肱，无咎。
九四：豐其蔀，日中見斗，遇其夷主，吉。
六五：來章，有慶譽，吉。
上六：豐其屋，蔀其家，闚其戶，闃其无人，三歲不覿，凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Yù qí pèi zhǔ, suī xún wú jiù, wǎng yǒu shàng.
Liù èr: Fēng qí bù, rì zhōng jiàn dòu, wǎng dé yí jí, yǒu fú fā ruò, jí.
Jiǔ sān: Fēng qí pèi, rì zhōng jiàn mèi, zhé qí yòu gōng, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sì: Fēng qí bù, rì zhōng jiàn dòu, yù qí yí zhǔ, jí.
Liù wǔ: Lái zhāng, yǒu qìng yù, jí.
Shàng liù: Fēng qí wū, bù qí jiā, kuī qí hù, qù qí wú rén, sān suì bù dí, xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Meeting one's matching lord. Even for ten days, no blame. Going on brings esteem.
Second line: The screen is so thick that the Dipper is seen at noon. Going brings suspicion and illness. If sincerity is shown, good fortune.
Third line: The curtain is so thick that small stars are seen at noon. He breaks his right arm. No blame.
Fourth line: The screen is so thick that the Dipper is seen at noon. He meets a lord of like mind. Good fortune.
Fifth line: Brilliance comes; there is blessing and praise. Good fortune.
Top line: A great house, a screened-off family. Peering through the door, it is silent, no one there. For three years nothing is seen. Misfortune.

judgment_pinyin: Xiǎo hēng, lǚ zhēn jí.
judgment_en: Small success. The traveler's perseverance brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六：旅瑣瑣，斯其所取災。
六二：旅即次，懷其資，得童僕貞。
九三：旅焚其次，喪其童僕，貞厲。
九四：旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。
六五：射雉一矢亡，終以譽命。
上九：鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑後號咷。喪牛于易，凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Lǚ suǒ suǒ, sī qí suǒ qǔ zāi.
Liù èr: Lǚ jí cì, huái qí zī, dé tóng pú zhēn.
Jiǔ sān: Lǚ fén qí cì, sàng qí tóng pú, zhēn lì.
Jiǔ sì: Lǚ yú chù, dé qí zī fǔ, wǒ xīn bù kuài.
Liù wǔ: Shè zhì yī shǐ wáng, zhōng yǐ yù mìng.
Shàng jiǔ: Niǎo fén qí cháo, lǚ rén xiān xiào hòu hào táo. Sàng niú yú yì, xiōng.
lines_en: First line: The traveler busies himself with petty things; this brings him disaster.
Second line: The traveler reaches an inn with his money; he gains a loyal young servant.
Third line: The traveler's inn burns; he loses his young servant. Perseverance brings danger.
Fourth line: The traveler finds a place to stay and gains money and an axe. My heart is not glad.
Fifth line: He shoots a pheasant and loses one arrow; in the end he wins praise and office.
Top line: The bird's nest burns. The traveler laughs first, then wails. He loses his ox at Yi. Misfortune.

judgment_pinyin: Xiǎo hēng, lì yōu wǎng, lì jiàn dà rén.
judgment_en: Small success. Favorable to go somewhere. Favorable to see the great man.
lines_zh: 初六：進退，利武人之貞。
九二：巽在床下，用史巫紛若，吉，无咎。
九三：頻巽，吝。
六四：悔亡，田獲三品。
九五：貞吉悔亡，无不利。无初有終，先庚三日，後庚三日，吉。
上九：巽在床下，喪其資斧，貞凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Jìn tuì, lì wǔ rén zhī zhēn.
Jiǔ èr: Xùn zài chuáng xià, yòng shǐ wū fēn ruò, jí, wú jiù.
Jiǔ sān: Pín xùn, lìn.
Liù sì: Huǐ wáng, tián huò sān pǐn.
Jiǔ wǔ: Zhēn jí huǐ wáng, wú bù lì. Wú chū yǒu zhōng, xiān gēng sān rì, hòu gēng sān rì, jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Xùn zài chuáng xià, sàng qí zī fǔ, zhēn xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Advancing and retreating. Favorable is a warrior's perseverance.
Second line: Penetrating beneath the bed; diviners and shamans used in great number. Good fortune, no blame.
Third line: Repeated penetrating. Humiliation.
Fourth line: Regret vanishes. In the hunt, three kinds of game are caught.
Fifth line: Perseverance brings good fortune; regret vanishes; nothing unfavorable. No beginning, but an end. Three days before the change, three days after. Good fortune.
Top line: Penetrating beneath the bed, he loses his money and his axe. Perseverance brings misfortune.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng, lì zhēn.
judgment_en: Success. Favorable perseverance.
lines_zh: 初九：和兌，吉。
九二：孚兌，吉，悔亡。
六三：來兌，凶。
九四：商兌，未寧，介疾有喜。
九五：孚于剝，有厲。
上六：引兌。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Hé duì, jí.
Jiǔ èr: Fú duì, jí, huǐ wáng.
Liù sān: Lái duì, xiōng.
Jiǔ sì: Shāng duì, wèi níng, jiè jí yǒu xǐ.
Jiǔ wǔ: Fú yú bō, yǒu lì.
Shàng liù: Yǐn duì.
lines_en: First line: Harmonious joy. Good fortune.
Second line: Sincere joy. Good fortune; regret vanishes.
Third line: Joy that is sought. Misfortune.
Fourth line: Joy weighed and bargained, not yet at peace. Keep away from the sickness, and there is joy.
Fifth line: Trusting what erodes. There is danger.
Top line: Joy that is drawn out.

judgment_zh: 亨。王假有廟，利涉大川，利貞。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Wáng jiǎ yǒu miào, lì shè dà chuān, lì zhēn.
judgment_en: Success. The king approaches his temple. Favorable to cross the great river. Favorable perseverance.
lines_zh: 初六：用拯馬壯，吉。
九二：渙奔其机，悔亡。
六三：渙其躬，无悔。
六四：渙其群，元吉。渙有丘，匪夷所思。
九五：渙汗其大號，渙王居，无咎。
上九：渙其血，去逖出，无咎。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Yòng zhěng mǎ zhuàng, jí.
Jiǔ èr: Huàn bēn qí jī, huǐ wáng.
Liù sān: Huàn qí gōng, wú huǐ.
Liù sì: Huàn qí qún, yuán jí. Huàn yǒu qiū, fěi yí suǒ sī.
Jiǔ wǔ: Huàn hàn qí dà hào, huàn wáng jū, wú jiù.
Shàng jiǔ: Huàn qí xuè, qù tì chū, wú jiù.
lines_en: First line: Rescue with a strong horse. Good fortune.
Second line: In dispersion, he hurries to his support. Regret vanishes.
Third line: Dispersing his self-concern. No regret.
Fourth line: Dispersing his faction. Supreme good fortune. Dispersing to gather a mound — beyond ordinary thought.
Fifth line: Dispersing like sweat, his great proclamation; dispersing the king's stores. No blame.
Top line: Dispersing the bloodshed, he goes far away. No blame.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng. Kǔ jié, bù kě zhēn.
judgment_en: Success. Bitter restraint should not be persisted in.
lines_zh: 初九：不出戶庭，无咎。
九二：不出門庭，凶。
六三：不節若，則嗟若，无咎。
六四：安節，亨。
九五：甘節，吉；往有尚。
上六：苦節，貞凶，悔亡。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Bù chū hù tíng, wú jiù.
Jiǔ èr: Bù chū mén tíng, xiōng.
Liù sān: Bù jié ruò, zé jiē ruò, wú jiù.
Liù sì: Ān jié, hēng.
Jiǔ wǔ: Gān jié, jí; wǎng yǒu shàng.
Shàng liù: Kǔ jié, zhēn xiōng, huǐ wáng.
lines_en: First line: Not leaving the inner courtyard. No blame.
Second line: Not leaving the outer gate. Misfortune.
Third line: Without restraint, there is lamenting. No blame.
Fourth line: Restraint at ease. Success.
Fifth line: Sweet restraint. Good fortune; going on brings esteem.
Top line: Bitter restraint. Perseverance brings misfortune; regret vanishes.

judgment_pinyin: Tún yú jí, lì shè dà chuān, lì zhēn.
judgment_en: Pigs and fish: good fortune. Favorable to cross the great river. Favorable perseverance.
lines_zh: 初九：虞吉，有它不燕。
九二：鳴鶴在陰，其子和之，我有好爵，吾與爾靡之。
六三：得敵，或鼓或罷，或泣或歌。
六四：月幾望，馬匹亡，无咎。
九五：有孚攣如，无咎。
上九：翰音登于天，貞凶。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Yú jí, yǒu tā bù yàn.
Jiǔ èr: Míng hè zài yīn, qí zi hé zhī, wǒ yǒu hǎo jué, wú yǔ ěr mí zhī.
Liù sān: Dé dí, huò gǔ huò bà, huò qì huò gē.
Liù sì: Yuè jǐ wàng, mǎ pǐ wáng, wú jiù.
Jiǔ wǔ: Yǒu fú luán rú, wú jiù.
Shàng jiǔ: Hàn yīn dēng yú tiān, zhēn xiōng.
lines_en: First line: Being prepared brings good fortune; other designs bring no peace.
Second line: A crane calls in the shade; its young answer. I have a fine cup of wine; I will share it with you.
Third line: Meeting an opponent: now drumming, now stopping, now weeping, now singing.
Fourth line: The moon is nearly full; one of the paired horses is lost. No blame.
Fifth line: Sincerity that binds together. No blame.
Top line: The sound of wings rises to heaven. Perseverance brings misfortune.

judgment_zh: 亨，利貞，可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上，宜下，大吉。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng, lì zhēn, kě xiǎo shì, bù kě dà shì. Fēi niǎo yí zhī yīn, bù yí shàng, yí xià, dà jí.
judgment_en: Success. Favorable perseverance. Small matters can be done, not great ones. The flying bird leaves its call behind: not fitting to go up, fitting to stay down. Great good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六：飛鳥以凶。
六二：過其祖，遇其妣；不及其君，遇其臣；无咎。
九三：弗過防之，從或戕之，凶。
九四：无咎，弗過遇之。往厲必戒，勿用永貞。
六五：密雲不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。
上六：弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Fēi niǎo yǐ xiōng.
Liù èr: Guò qí zǔ, yù qí bǐ; bù jí qí jūn, yù qí chén; wú jiù.
Jiǔ sān: Fú guò fáng zhī, cóng huò qiāng zhī, xiōng.
Jiǔ sì: Wú jiù, fú guò yù zhī. Wǎng lì bì jiè, wù yòng yǒng zhēn.
Liù wǔ: Mì yún bù yǔ, zì wǒ xī jiāo, gōng yì qǔ bǐ zài xué.
Shàng liù: Fú yù guò zhī, fēi niǎo lí zhī, xiōng, shì wèi zāi shěng.
lines_en: First line: The bird flies, and so meets misfortune.
Second line: Passing the grandfather, meeting the grandmother; not reaching the lord, meeting the minister. No blame.
Third line: Not guarding beyond the usual, someone may strike from behind. Misfortune.
Fourth line: No blame. Not passing, he meets it. Going on is dangerous; be on guard. Do not hold to lasting perseverance.
Fifth line: Dense clouds, no rain, from our western outskirts. The duke shoots and takes the one in the cave.
Top line: Not meeting, he passes by; the flying bird is caught in the net. Misfortune; this is called disaster.

judgment_pinyin: Hēng, xiǎo lì zhēn, chū jí zhōng luàn.
judgment_en: Success in small things. Favorable perseverance. Good fortune at the start, disorder at the end.
lines_zh: 初九：曳其輪，濡其尾，无咎。
六二：婦喪其茀，勿逐，七日得。
九三：高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。
六四：繻有衣袽，終日戒。
九五：東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之禴祭，實受其福。
上六：濡其首，厲。
lines_pinyin: Chū jiǔ: Yè qí lún, rú qí wěi, wú jiù.
Liù èr: Fù sàng qí fú, wù zhú, qī rì dé.
Jiǔ sān: Gāo zōng fá guǐ fāng, sān nián kè zhī, xiǎo rén wù yòng.
Liù sì: Xū yǒu yī rú, zhōng rì jiè.
Jiǔ wǔ: Dōng lín shā niú, bù rú xī lín zhī yuè jì, shí shòu qí fú.
Shàng liù: Rú qí shǒu, lì.
lines_en: First line: He brakes his wheels and wets his tail. No blame.
Second line: The woman loses her carriage curtain. Do not chase it; in seven days it is regained.
Third line: Gaozong attacks the Demon Land; after three years he conquers it. Do not employ petty people.
Fourth line: Fine silk turns to rags; be on guard all day.
Fifth line: The eastern neighbor's slaughtered ox is not equal to the western neighbor's simple offering, which truly receives the blessing.
Top line: He wets his head. Danger.

judgment_zh: 亨，小狐汔濟，濡其尾，无攸利。
judgment_pinyin: Hēng, xiǎo hú qì jì, rú qí wěi, wú yōu lì.
judgment_en: Success. The little fox, nearly across, wets its tail. Nothing favorable.
lines_zh: 初六：濡其尾，吝。
九二：曳其輪，貞吉。
六三：未濟，征凶，利涉大川。
九四：貞吉，悔亡，震用伐鬼方，三年有賞于大國。
六五：貞吉，无悔，君子之光，有孚，吉。
上九：有孚于飲酒，无咎，濡其首，有孚失是。
lines_pinyin: Chū liù: Rú qí wěi, lìn.
Jiǔ èr: Yè qí lún, zhēn jí.
Liù sān: Wèi jì, zhēng xiōng, lì shè dà chuān.
Jiǔ sì: Zhēn jí, huǐ wáng, zhèn yòng fá guǐ fāng, sān nián yǒu shǎng yú dà guó.
Liù wǔ: Zhēn jí, wú huǐ, jūn zǐ zhī guāng, yǒu fú, jí.
Shàng jiǔ: Yǒu fú yú yǐn jiǔ, wú jiù, rú qí shǒu, yǒu fú shī shì.
lines_en: First line: He wets his tail. Humiliation.
Second line: He brakes his wheels. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Third line: Not yet across: setting forth brings misfortune. Favorable to cross the great river.
Fourth line: Perseverance brings good fortune; regret vanishes. Rousing to attack the Demon Land; after three years, rewarded by the great state.
Fifth line: Perseverance brings good fortune; no regret. The light of the noble one; there is sincerity. Good fortune.
Top line: There is sincerity in drinking wine; no blame. If he wets his head, sincerity is lost.
